case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You pointed to alloy and material costs as the reason for your price, so we have looked at exactly those lines.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own order history with you:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: with the alloy and bar cost lines falling and our price history flat, it gives you a longer contract term and a firm base price without any clause to administer.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since this goes beyond your own desk, please take Option A to the person who decides on pricing at your end. We are glad to supply whatever your approval needs.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. Please note that our AS-14404 material is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning recent index drops do not immediately reduce our costs. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While we do not provide internal cost breakdowns, we have reviewed the market indices and your order history.

Our offer is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.32 per unit, with a price of €5.32 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
